Anna: Quick design review for Deployments & Rollouts UI — focusing on the variant switcher (A/B), canary slider, rollback flow, and version history timeline. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/Deployments-UI. Posting a few screenshots and the main concerns. Can we get UX + accessibility + infra quick takes before the Tues design review? :eyes: Mike: Overall looks great. Two quick nits: 1) timeline gets very dense >20 versions — can we collapse by day/week? 2) variant badges rely on color only to indicate treatment, that's an accessibility problem. :thumbsup: Julia: Collapse makes sense. Expandable day headers with counts would be easy to implement. Also for the canary traffic control — are we planning a custom slider or native ? Native gives keyboard affordances out of the box. Sam: From infra side: we can stream live traffic metrics but it's nontrivial cost-wise. For preview numbers we can show a deterministic snapshot from the routing config (cheaper). Also flag: rollbacks should be idempotent and recorded as metadata events, not destructive ops. Priya: Accessibility checklist: slider must be keyboard-operable with 1% steps, include aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow/aria-label, visible focus styles, and accessible tooltips. Don't convey promoted/primary only by color — add an icon or text label (e.g., 'Prod'). Contrast: variant badge text should meet 4.5:1 for small text. Mike: Copy tweak suggestion: change primary action from 'Promote' to 'Promote to production' to reduce ambiguity. Rollback confirmation should read: "This will revert traffic to version X and may invalidate sessions. Continue?" Keep it short but informative. Anna: Good calls. One more: thinking about giving users a toggle top-right: 'Timeline | Diff' — timeline for audit, diff for quick compare + revert. Thoughts? Julia: Diff view will need side-by-side for model config, env vars, and quant flags. We can reuse the eval-diff component but we'll need a structured JSON -> diff renderer. Also note long artifact IDs — trim in UI to 8 chars with hover to show full. Sam: Implementation note: store canary weights as integer permille (0-1000) to avoid float rounding. Backend will accept permille and convert to percent display. Also add a server-side safety limit on auto-rollout increments. Priya: More ARIA specifics: timeline should be a
    and entries
  • . Expand buttons need aria-expanded and aria-controls attributes. Keyboard focus must land on each interactive element in a logical order. Julia: Example accessible slider we can use (HTML snippet): ```html 10% ``` Julia: We should also provide +/- buttons next to the slider for precise keyboard increments (and for screen reader users). deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Mock deploy registered — canary 10% -> ver 2026-03-17-14. ID: dpl_4f3. Use `/deploy status dpl_4f3` to inspect. Mike: Visual nit: timeline event backgrounds are competing with status chips. Suggest using a subtle left border color for status and keep the entry background neutral to preserve contrast. Anna: Great feedback — I'll update Figma with: collapsed-by-day timeline option, 'Timeline | Diff' toggle, copy tweaks, and accessible slider + +/- controls. Will also add icon labels for variants. I'll drop updated screens by EOD and schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 11:00am to walk through. :calendar:
